invariants.rule: append-only execution evidence must-not change planning digests
invariants.positive_case: implementation and verification JSONL append leaves all planning digests stable
invariants.negative_case: mutable execution evidence makes requirements, overview, detail, or implement review stale

invariants.rule: Full selection failure must-not fall back to light design.md
invariants.positive_case: missing or invalid Full manifest blocks with an artifact error
invariants.negative_case: the task-local pointer design.md is silently hashed as Full detail

invariants.rule: canonicalization profile change must-not reuse older digest as current
invariants.positive_case: older profile evidence remains auditable but stale
invariants.negative_case: a v1 digest is silently accepted as v2 current clean evidence

invariants.rule: artifact/section boundary parsing and semantic changes must-not invalidate unrelated gates or preserve dependent gates
invariants.positive_case: fence-aware unfenced section boundaries plus the declared artifact-key matrix invalidate only descendants
invariants.negative_case: a fenced ## §2 splits Lite sections, Lite detail stales Overview, or Overview change leaves Detail current

invariants.rule: v1-to-v2 review cutover must freeze v1 and require managed-adapter v2 re-review of unchanged predecessor/self snapshots without auto-migration, dual write or mixed readiness
invariants.positive_case: read-only plan and CAS activation switch one authority before current V2 reviews
invariants.negative_case: V1 rows are promoted, V1 and V2 each contribute a clean, or changed bridge snapshots are accepted

invariants.rule: records sharing a trusted reviewer principal or trusted context principal must-not count as independent
invariants.positive_case: both provider-scoped reviewer and context principals differ and all attestations are current
invariants.negative_case: same reviewer with new worker, thread or run id, or a different reviewer in the same context, counts twice

invariants.rule: prose-only finding changes must-not reset stagnation
invariants.positive_case: finding fingerprint remains stable across wording and line-shift changes
invariants.negative_case: message rewriting is treated as a new finding and restarts repair budget

invariants.rule: tampered/stale records must-not count as current clean
invariants.positive_case: record chain, trusted identity and reviewed digest all validate
invariants.negative_case: edited, reordered, deleted, stale, or self-attested review record counts as clean

invariants.rule: review record durability must-not be described as malicious-rewrite security or bypass lock/hash-chain/fsync
invariants.positive_case: authority is validated separately while framed append detects torn, reordered or accidental edits
invariants.negative_case: a recomputed task JSON chain authenticates a reviewer or a concurrent/torn write counts clean

invariants.rule: TrustedReviewEnvelopeV1 must bind trusted runner/platform authority plus task, gate, artifact, policy, inventory, result, severity and findings digest without self-reported identity fallback
invariants.positive_case: pinned capable adapter captures platform control-plane identity and every envelope binding matches
invariants.negative_case: assistant prose, --as, unsupported adapter or a mutated binding counts as independent clean
